_README: Config for fetch_browser.mjs — bot-blocked employers whose own career sites (and clean ATS APIs) cannot be read by plain HTTP (UBS Brassring 403s even headless; Swiss Re behind Cloudflare; Zurich Insurance custom). For each: a headless browser tries the DIRECT employer site first; if that yields nothing it falls back to the jobs.ch AGGREGATOR, filtered to that exact company. Aggregator-sourced roles are clearly marked (aggregator:true, linkStatus SEARCH, a verify note) per the family rule: direct first, aggregator only as fallback, always labelled. Title/location filters are reused from ats_sources.json (single source of truth).
